sections.heading: Terrain Snowoperator
sections.content: The Terrain Snow operator can be used to place snow on terrain grids.

sections.heading: Terrain snow
sections.content:
Grid names: terrain grids with matching names will have snow applied to them.Color channel: when enabled, snow effects will be applied to the specified color channel.Mask channel: when enabled, the mask of areas on a terrain grid affected by snow effects will be saved to the specified channel.Color: the base color of snow effects.Amount: the base depth of snow that will be applied to the terrain grid.

Grid names: terrain grids with matching names will have snow applied to them.

Color channel: when enabled, snow effects will be applied to the specified color channel.

Mask channel: when enabled, the mask of areas on a terrain grid affected by snow effects will be saved to the specified channel.

Color: the base color of snow effects.

Amount: the base depth of snow that will be applied to the terrain grid.

sections.heading: Terrain
sections.content: Snow line: controls the world-space height, above which snow will be generated.

sections.heading: Ice
sections.content: Thickness: Snow amounts below this value in height will have their color interpolated up from 0, giving it an ice-like appearance.

sections.heading: Compact snow
sections.content:
Compact snow is dense snow that follows the contours of the underlying terrain closely.

Spread: controls how compact snow is distributed over details on the terrain. Higher values will retain less detail.Rest angle: controls the maximum terrain slope angle that can hold compact snow.Rest height multiplier: artificially boosts the height of compact snow on the terrain grid.

Spread: controls how compact snow is distributed over details on the terrain. Higher values will retain less detail.

Rest angle: controls the maximum terrain slope angle that can hold compact snow.

Rest height multiplier: artificially boosts the height of compact snow on the terrain grid.

sections.heading: Powder snow
sections.content:
Powder snow is light snow that forms softer/smooth piles/mounds on the underlying terrain grid.

Spread: controls how powder snow is distributed over details on the detail. Higher values will retain less detail.Mount height: controls the height of snow mounds that form on the edges of areas affected by powder snow.Slip angle: controls the maximum terrain slope angle that can hold powder snow.Slip falloff: controls how powder snow smoothly falls off from areas satisfying the slip angle threshold.

Spread: controls how powder snow is distributed over details on the detail. Higher values will retain less detail.

Mount height: controls the height of snow mounds that form on the edges of areas affected by powder snow.

Slip angle: controls the maximum terrain slope angle that can hold powder snow.

Slip falloff: controls how powder snow smoothly falls off from areas satisfying the slip angle threshold.

sections.heading: Sunlight
sections.content:
Sunlight object: the object used to determine the location of the sun, relative to the terrain.Melt amount: controls how much snow will melt on areas directly exposed to the sun.

Sunlight object: the object used to determine the location of the sun, relative to the terrain.

Melt amount: controls how much snow will melt on areas directly exposed to the sun.
